_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Request for Waiver (RFW)
summary: Provides the format, content, and preparation instructions for a Request for Waiver used to obtain authorization to deliver nonconforming items to the Government.
use_relationship:
A Request for Waiver is used during or after manufacture to obtain authorization to deliver nonconforming items to the Government, which do not comply with the applicable technical requirements.  For the unit(s) affected, the different configuration will normally be permanent.

A Request for Waiver enables the Government to determine the impact on performance, operational readiness, logistics support or other affected areas.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content and preparation instructions for the data product resulting from the work task specified in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Request for Waiver (RFW) shall be prepared in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The RFW content shall include the consideration to be provided if the Government accepts the request for waiver, and where applicable, the following information:

children.title: A complete description of the contract requirement affected and the nature of the waiver (non-conformance)
Number of units (and serial/lot numbers) to be delivered in this configuration
Any impacts to logistics support elements
children.content: Any impacts to logistics support elements (such as software, manuals, spares, tools, and similar) being utilized by government personnel or to the operational use of the product.

children.title: Information about remedial actions being taken to prevent reoccurrence of the non-conformance
